scope: Add a preparation-readiness gate before receptor parameterization. Do not model, delete, or silently tolerate any incomplete standard amino-acid residue. Recompute structural standardization and max-min selection over the fully observed candidates plus the frame-only 2RGP seed.

reference_frame_exception.role: alignment and max-min seed only; not a docking receptor
reference_frame_exception.reason: 2RGP has one incomplete Glu1015 side chain outside the frozen ATP pocket

selection.feature_standardization_population: 17 preparation-ready candidates plus the 2RGP frame-only seed
selection.selection_rule: deterministic max-min structural distance from the frame-only reference seed; ties resolved by lexical conformer ID
selection.failure_action: stop before production docking if fewer than 16 selected receptors pass cognate-ligand redocking

redocking_plan.reserve_policy: the single reserve may replace one failed selected receptor only through a separately recorded deterministic replacement step followed by the same redocking gate

authorization: Finalize the 16 preparation-ready receptors and one reserve, then build a Uni-Dock cognate-ligand redocking input bundle. EGFR benchmark ligand docking remains unauthorized.
interpretation_boundary: This gate avoids modeled or deleted receptor residues and fixes the technical redocking cohort. It does not establish redocking success, screening enrichment, QUBO portability, QUBO superiority, quantum application, or quantum advantage.
